body:
The Author selects direct-row road rendering as the FIRST Rally experiment, ahead of async UART and independent physics/render scheduling. Task and prior dirt are checkpoint-pushed through0715d5f. Please provide bounded runtime/SDK integration guidance and identify an EXISTING immutable row-enabled closure suitable for a matched Rally bitmap-vs-direct-row comparison; no new generic hook is requested and no peer build/run is requested by this mail.

Baseline native479fe1ac99bb2895af8a8b6cca49b90cb5c346a56a5f9e4020cab0b23c933918 uses old SDK and firmware8da2ebfdfa3b5b00f4a1929ad4885c838845b160f570259792ef370b69d4f473. Complete900-frame C8 run just passes all2024replies/independent finalstate/cleanup at24.68MOS/24.73PRTFPS; mean40.44ms/frame,2.97ms synchronous send,27.92ms combined replywait. No installed-ROM identity or optical timing captured. Old artifacts stay fixed.

Road currently writes opaque AABBGGRR into320x120 buffer50700, then emits bitmap plot; actors use additive-generated retained bitmaps and normal Canvas plotting. Candidate will keep geometry/span edge stepping/actor sampler/sky/HUD/audio/physics/fences identical, write same road pixels into hidden SBGR2222 rows (per-row resolution, XOR2, preserve0xc0, mask0x3f), END before actor/Canvas work, no presentation after error. Host READ16 callback remains legacy10B and one outstanding render.

Questions: (1) Which existing runtime firmware BIN/ELF, SDK header/builder export and manifest/source pins should we use? Prefer functional qualified rows composition with needed old bitmap/font behavior, and state UART receiver patch/mode-recovery/profile differences explicitly. Existing7e7dfrontend/plain086backend can be retained if compatible. (2) Confirm finite road-only BEGIN/ROW/END with up to4ordinary leases coexists, no service gaps, sync-bit layout requirements; note any entry/startup interactions we must change in BOTH arms. (3) Recommended compiler policy/limits for this comparison: old module has32264text/504B selected headroom; current PSRAM policy may grow it. We will not silently repin/relabel old binaries or raise resource guards. If a different runtime needs a new owner build, report that dependency rather than starting one from this mail.

Rally owns code/host checks/finite silent Oryx cohort, later Author review/hardware package. No physical flash, GUI, async TX or scheduler change now. Reply by durable mailbox plus immediate Pi-native steering to Rally01a1346d-a74a-7211-b5b7-de3bcb8a28e5. Retired Golem chat remains untouched. This is an authorized consumer contract query, not a restart of predecessor work.
